tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sgrol ma dkar mo'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so//

༄༅// 'jigs pa ma lus pa bskyab cing 'chi ba med pa dang bsod nams blo gros kyi dpal stsol bar mdzad pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar po la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig la ni// sbyin sreg khri phrag byed par bshad// ces bshad pa ltar/ bzlas pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu'i cha'i sbyin sreg bya dgos shing*/ de bas na sgrol ma dkar mo'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi dang*/ nyi zla gzas gzung ba'i dus sam/ gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa bzang po la 'phags ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ bdag bskyed mchod bstod sgrub thabs bzhin tshar nas/ 'chi blu las/ zho dang sbrang rtsi la mar bskus// dūr ba'i myu gu shar dang ni// byang du rtse bstan sbyin sreg bya// sngon gyi las mthu las byung ba'i// 'chi ba nges par bzlog par byed// ces pas/ srog chags med pa'i sa dkar po la rkyang nul legs par byas/ tshangs zur gyi thig btab nas/ de'i dbus nas sor bcu gnyis bcal ba'i mtha' nas zlum por bskor/ de'i phyi nas yang zlum skor sor bzhi pa gsum gyis bskor/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/ phyi'i sor bzhi pa gsum la mu ran kha khyer khor yug rnams kyang dkar por bya/ de dag gi bcad kyi re khā dmar po/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rnams bri/ pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba la lha mtshan 'god/ zho can gyi bud shing sor bcu gnyis pa'am/ dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba skam po srog chags med pa la dri bzang gi chus sbags te/ mu ran gyi nang nas tshags dam par sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad du brtsig mtha' mchod pas bskor/ sgrub pa po kha shar du bltas te skyil krung ngam tsog pur 'dug rang gi g.yas su sreg rdzas/ g.yon du mchod rdzas/

mdun du rdor dril dang*/ dgang gzar dgang blugs kha sbyar la bzhag 'das gtor dang me lha'i dkar gtor yang bsham/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas tal 'bar la me sbar ba bzung ste/ oṃ tā re'i sngags lan gsum gyis g.yas su gsum bskor/ rtswa skam dang bcas pas me thab tu bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra dzñā na hūṃ zhes pa dang*/ snying po bzla zhing dgang blugs kyis mar lan bdun phul la me gso/ oṃ a mṛ ta ud bha wa ud bha wa hūṃ phaṭ/ ces las sngags bzlas pa'i chus yo byad bsang zhing*/ oṃ swa swā hā/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ dz+riṃswā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ thab bsangs/ swa bhā was stong pa'i ngang las/ thab paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje 'phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi'i grwa bzhir rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ dbyibs zlum po mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ yang mchod rdzas sreg rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang bar snang thams cad khyab pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā sogs so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ de nas thab kyi nang du paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du raṃ las bgrang 'phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ tshur 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dkar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba/ ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ag tshom can/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ bsam/ rang gi sa bon las 'od 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par mos te/ dbyug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna drung du bcas la/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+neḥte dzaḥ sarba karma pra sā dha ka kā ru ṇā kṛ te dza sa twa kaṃ aṣ+min san+ni he tu bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+wa ཾ zhes me tog dor la gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sa mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ gyis zhabs bsil phul nas/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ zhes rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa lā ya sarba bhismiṃ ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūṃ phaṭ/ dṝ ṣ+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a haṃ gis dam la bzhag oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ la sogs pas dgug gzhug bcings dbang du byas sngar ltar dbang bskur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// 'di yis bdag gi bgegs zhi zhing*// mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes pas ku sha'i rtse mo g.yas su bstan te thabs kyi phyogs brgyad du bskor zhing*/ sngar gyi las sngags kyi chus bsangs nas/ me lha'i lce hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i kha dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ lan bdun gyis bkang ste kha sbyar la/ oṃ ag+ne ye a dhi bya a ti bya/ a bi sha a bi sha ma hā shrī bya/

ha bya/ ka bya/ ma hā na ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis dgang blugs gsum gyis byon zas phul la/ me lha la ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭāk+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ 'ba' zhig gis phul nas/ re re'i mjug tu spel tshig brjod de/ yaṃ shing la/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar la/ 'byor pa/ til la/ dge ba/ zas mchog la/ bde ba/ 'bras la/ bsod nams rgyas pa/ so ba la/ nor dang 'bru/ nas la/ shugs/ sran ma la/ stobs/ gro la/ nad med pa/ dūr ba la/ tshe/ ku sha la/ bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sreg rdzas so so'i sngags kyis 'bul na/ rim bzhin / oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra yes 'bul lo// de nas sngar bzhin mchod bstod bsangs gtor zhabs bsil phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ thab kyi dbus su/ lha mtshan paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ yig dkar po nas hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ po ṭa la nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren par mos pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs can skur ston pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol//

zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa nas/ rgyas btab pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas nas lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ mar la sngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis bkang la/ oṃ ag+ne ya a dhi bya'i sngags kyi mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes mer blugs pa lan gsum bya/ sgrub thabs bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ de nas rdzas thams cad oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā sa phul la/ spel tshig me lha'i skabs bzhin la til sum brgya la sogs pa mang du phul/ gzhan rnams brgya rtsa re re 'bul/ sgrub thabs bzhin mchod bstod/ gtor ma/ 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa/ yig brgya bzla ba/ bzod gsol gshegs skyems mar khu lan bdun 'bul ba gong bzhin byas la / ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ slar yang badz+ra dz+wa la'i sngags kyis mar dgang blugs lan gsum gyis mar thab tu blugs la/ me lha'i skur bzhengs par bsams nas/ sngar gyi me lha'i skabs bzhin sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams nyi shu rtsa re dang*/ gshegs skyems bdun dang*/ mchod pa phul/ gtor ma ag+ne ya sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro zhes sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa dang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi bcud ldan ghan+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal//

zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ bsang gtor sngar bzhin dang*/ 'thor 'thung prok+ṣā ṇāṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji ltar gnas su slar gshegs te// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+ne ya ya hi/ zhes pas me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ kha bskang ba'i phyir yig brgya bzla/ bkra shis brjod/ me ma shi bar mi brdal/ mi 'gong*/ gal te me gsod na 'o mas bran la thal ba ri mthon po'i rtse'am rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chur gdan drangs na bsod nams che'o// de ltar rje btsun ma'i sbyin sreg 'di ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes kyi sku gcig tu bsdus pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bkas gyis shig gsung ba la brten nas/ shākya'i dge slong mi pham pad+ma dkar pos/ sgrub pa'i skyed tshal phun tshogs nor bu'i gling du sbyar ba/ gong ma'i yig cha gzhir bzhag bya rgyud kyi sbyin sreg gzhan mas kha bskang ste dag par byas pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
